rationale.tooling-supply-chain: Demonstrates contextual-bias attacks directly compromising deployed AI code reviewers.
rationale.ai-review: Empirically establishes severe reliability limits in LLM vulnerability judgments.
rationale.built-system: Implements and evaluates an iterative attack pipeline and realistic testbed.
rationale.general-code: AI reviews general pull-request code, not specifically AI-generated code.
rationale.steering: Attacks and defenses substantively manipulate the review model's input context.
rationale.risk-security: Experiments reintroduce known CVEs and measure failed vulnerability detection.
rationale.method-experiment: Controlled manipulations characterize six models and cloned third-party review pipelines.
